description: Create an action set with new actions (Actions panel > Create New Set, Create New Action) from steps recorded in saved .aia files: each new action lists the steps it copies, as a whole saved action or one numbered step of it, and can switch each step or its dialog on or off. Then load the set, save it as an .aia file, or both. Steps cannot be recorded here; record them in Illustrator and save the set first

enabled.description: Include the step in playback (Toggle Item On/Off)

filePath.description: Absolute .aia path holding the recorded action

showDialog.description: Stop at the step's dialog during playback (Toggle Dialog On/Off). Only for steps that have a dialog

step.description: One step of it, 1 = first. Default every step

load.description: Load it into Illustrator. Default true

replace.description: same_name (default): unload a loaded set with the same name first, so the panel does not get a second copy; all: unload every set first (Replace Actions); none: add alongside

saveAs.description: Write the set to this .aia path

name: create_action_set
title: Create Action Set
